content.short: MultiPass gives internationally trading businesses multi-currency accounts, virtual IBANs, FX and cards.
content.description: MultiPass is a UK-based business financial platform that gives internationally trading companies multi-currency accounts to send, receive and exchange money worldwide. Regulated as an electronic money institution by the UK FCA, with a branch under the Dubai Financial Services Authority, it offers virtual IBANs, local receiving accounts, foreign exchange across more than 70 currencies, corporate cards, batch payments and open-banking APIs. MultiPass targets e-commerce sellers, import-export firms, agencies and startups that need reliable cross-border payments across 200-plus countries without maintaining separate bank accounts in each market. By consolidating accounts, FX, cards and payments, it simplifies collections, payouts and reconciliation for global businesses.
